purpose: Controlled component screening and separate reliability revision validation; no baseline reruns
controller_release: min(60, 1 + step*60//500), same as frozen v3; at most 37 in 300 steps and 60 in 500 steps
dependent_actions: sequential within each game; no speculative paid branches

remnant.remaining_steps_after_method_failure: no further reward credited; early algorithm failure retained

ablations.no_checks: v3 joint quantity, task parameter, station, capacity and surplus vetoes become advisory; factual ledger retained
ablations.no_execution: v3 automatic dependency preparation and committed short-plan execution disabled; fresh actor proposals still checked
ablations.no_repeat: v3 repeated-context action and unchanged-inspection hard vetoes become advisory
ablations.no_hypothesis: v3 separate typed hypothesis proposal, trial marking and prompt feedback removed; review and actor budgets unchanged

v4_frozen_reliability_changes: unreported inventory remains uncertain; capacity failure only constrains same observed load, attempted action, location, epoch and life
death invalidates operational constraints; law rewrite also invalidates object-capability and inspection caches
explicit not-equippable feedback persists as object capability until rule rewrite
unsupported or contradicted objectives cannot remain locked; old objective may be revalidated after death
successful navigation recurrence becomes advisory; unchanged failed actions and repeated inspections remain checked unless their group is removed
fresh actor proposal precedes old plan/preparation after hazard, task, visibility or reset changes
selection: At most one component group removed. Both 300-step screening runs must finish with valid scores, Remnant must strictly beat its frozen v3 reference and Metropolis must not regress. Rank qualifying groups by normalized total main gain (24/31 denominators), ties: no_hypothesis, no_execution, no_repeat, no_checks. If none qualify, retain all groups and apply only reliability revisions. No post-hoc threshold tuning.
phase_transition: after all 8 ablations stop, save selection, check provider balance once, then run selected v4 on all 3 games; no top-up, no automatic reruns
measurements: main/supplementary score, main score at step 300, early method versus API failures
zero-capacity vetoes, deaths, unchanged inspections, rejection types, main gain steps
observable objective effects, net dependency changes, typed tests
API call counts and prompt/completion tokens; no aggregate wall-time metric
prohibited_actor_inputs: game-specific hardcoded objects, recipes, maps or answers
frozen historical traces, baseline scores or offline validation fixtures
limitations: one stochastic trajectory per condition: screen, not significance or universal utility proof
same games used for development: no held-out generalization claim
v4 has several frozen reliability changes; its outcome cannot identify an individual repair effect
no factorial interaction estimates; at most one group removed to avoid combining untested deletions
method early exits remain failures with achieved score; infrastructure failures disqualify selection
